hero.title: Build the product, not the same plumbing again.
hero.description: A serious full-stack SaaS starter for authentication, billing, organizations, emails, files, admin tooling, and the operational paths every product needs.

auth.title: Auth and account security
auth.body: Supabase Auth, SSR sessions, route protection, profile settings, MFA-ready flows, and safe account deletion.

organizations.title: Organizations when needed
organizations.body: User-first by default, with optional workspaces, RBAC, invitations, and organization billing for B2B products.

billing.title: Billing and entitlements
billing.body: Stripe Checkout, Customer Portal, subscriptions, one-time credits, usage limits, and idempotent webhooks.

messaging.title: Transactional messaging
messaging.body: Pluggable SMTP/console email provider abstraction, React Email templates, notification preferences, and safe development email mode.

guardrails.title: Production guardrails
guardrails.body: RLS, typed config, structured errors, audit logs, file ownership, testing, and documentation from day one.
